title: SuperDes plans
answer:
Sample prices for reference, not a quote.
Starter: 0 EUR/month - 1 designer, 3 active projects, 5 render credits.
Studio: 49 EUR/month - 3 designers, 25 active projects, 40 render credits a month, studio branding.
Pro: 129 EUR/month - 10 designers, unlimited projects, 150 render credits a month, priority rendering.
Clients never pay for the app: the studio's plan covers them.

title: Render credits
answer:
Sample prices for reference, not a quote.
One render uses 1 credit; a failed render is refunded automatically. Extra packs: 20 credits for 15 EUR, 100 credits for 60 EUR. Credits belong to the studio, so ask your designer if you run out.

title: Designer fees
answer:
Sample prices for reference, not a quote.
Typical studio rates: 90 EUR per hour for consultation, or a package from 1,500 EUR for one room and 4,500 EUR for a full apartment. Your studio sets its own prices: ask your designer for theirs.

title: Your project estimate
answer:
Sample prices for reference, not a quote.
For your current plan and choices, the estimate is $estimate_low to $estimate_high $currency (your budget: $budget_max). It is built from generic furniture and finish prices, not real shop prices; see step 4, Dossier & budget, for the line items.

title: Paying and invoices
answer:
Sample prices for reference, not a quote.
The app does not take payments. Plans are billed to the studio monthly by invoice, and design fees are agreed directly with your designer.

title: Trying SuperDes for free
answer:
Sample prices for reference, not a quote.
The Starter plan is free with 5 render credits, and a studio's client link lets you try a guest project before registering.
